description: Angular component for 'Entity Limit Exceeded' dialog in Thingsboard UI, handling display, limit increase requests, and admin login.

classes.name: EntityLimitExceededDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and handling actions in the 'Entity Limit Exceeded' dialog.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dialog component, setting the limit reached text based on entity type and limit.

methods.name: requestLimitIncrease
methods.description: Sends a request to increase entity limit and shows confirmation alert.

methods.name: loginAsSysAdmin
methods.description: Logs out current user and redirects to tenant page as system admin.
